Real finding — thanks. Fixed with the existing pattern for binary-first extensions (`cognee-mcp`, `mbot-mcp`): `"show_install_link": false`, and the installation notes now spell out the manual add path (`goose session --with-extension "nika mcp"` / Settings → Extensions).

If maintainers would rather have the Install button work, I'm happy to send the one-line `deeplink.ts` allowlist addition instead (the `i-ching-mcp-server` precedent) — your call.
